description: Jarvis Registry proxy metrics: tool execution, discovery, resource access, and prompt execution across backend MCP servers.

targets.expr:
(
  sum(rate(mcp_tool_execution_total{status="success", server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))
  /
  (sum(rate(mcp_tool_execution_total{server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) > 0)
) * 100 or vector(100)
(floor(sum(increase(mcp_tool_execution_total{status="success", server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) by (server_name, tool_name))) OR on() vector(0)
(floor(sum(increase(mcp_tool_execution_total{status="failure", server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) by (server_name, tool_name))) OR on() vector(0)

(sum by (server_name, tool_name) (increase(mcp_tool_execution_total{status="success", server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))) /
(sum by (server_name, tool_name) (increase(mcp_tool_execution_total{server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range])) + 0.0001) * 100

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, server_name, tool_name) (rate(mcp_tool_execution_duration_seconds_bucket{server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method"}[$__range]))) * 1000
topk(10, sum by(error_type) (increase(mcp_tool_execution_total{status="failure", server_name=~"$server_name", tool_name=~"$tool_name", method=~"$method", error_type=~"$error_type"}[$__range])))

title: Jarvis-Registry Metrics
